scenes.title: Home from hospital. One result is still pending.
Keep the source and the uncertainty.
Name the person tracking the next step.
A result arriving is one step.
Give the follow-up a recorded ending.
A plan people can bring with them.
A useful prototype, with visible limits.
Every next step has a recorded ending.

cues.text: Anita is home from hospital. Her daughter, Maya, has the discharge notes.
cues.lines:
Anita is home from hospital. Her daughter, Maya, has the
discharge notes.

cues.text: But one result is still pending. Who will make sure somebody follows it through?
cues.lines:
But one result is still pending. Who will make sure somebody
follows it through?

cues.text: This is Looplight, a follow-up ledger by Shivam Gupta.
cues.lines: This is Looplight, a follow-up ledger by Shivam Gupta.

cues.text: It turns the next steps already written in discharge notes into a plan people can inspect and track.
cues.lines:
It turns the next steps already written in discharge notes
into a plan people can inspect and track.

cues.text: Start with Anita's fictional example. Open the source, then find the open loops.
cues.lines:
Start with Anita's fictional example. Open the source, then
find the open loops.

cues.text: A small trained text model and explicit rules suggest follow-up items.
cues.lines:
A small trained text model and explicit rules suggest
follow-up items.

cues.text: Nothing becomes a confirmed task until someone checks it.
cues.lines: Nothing becomes a confirmed task until someone checks it.

cues.text: Open the pending blood culture result. Its exact source sentence stays attached.
cues.lines:
Open the pending blood culture result. Its exact source
sentence stays attached.

cues.text: Missing timing appears as a question for the care team, so an unclear instruction stays visibly unresolved.
cues.lines:
Missing timing appears as a question for the care team, so
an unclear instruction stays visibly unresolved.

cues.text: A convincing task list can still miss something.
cues.lines: A convincing task list can still miss something.

cues.text: The original document remains reviewable sentence by sentence, including text the system did not turn into tasks.
cues.lines:
The original document remains reviewable sentence by
sentence, including text the system did not turn into tasks.

cues.text: Add a missed follow-up from its original sentence.
cues.lines: Add a missed follow-up from its original sentence.

cues.text: Now name Maya as the person tracking the result, review the details, and confirm the follow-up.
cues.lines:
Now name Maya as the person tracking the result, review the
details, and confirm the follow-up.

cues.text: Maya is tracking the next step. The app does not assign her clinical responsibility.
cues.lines:
Maya is tracking the next step. The app does not assign her
clinical responsibility.

cues.text: Here is the important distinction. Record that the result has arrived.
cues.lines:
Here is the important distinction. Record that the result
has arrived.

cues.text: The task stays open because receipt and clinician review are separate steps.
cues.lines:
The task stays open because receipt and clinician review are
separate steps.

cues.text: A file arriving does not tell the family what happens next.
cues.lines: A file arriving does not tell the family what happens next.

cues.text: After a conversation with the clinician, record who reviewed the result and what they said.
cues.lines:
After a conversation with the clinician, record who reviewed
the result and what they said.

cues.text: Confirm that this is your report, then record completion.
cues.lines: Confirm that this is your report, then record completion.

cues.text: The history preserves a user-reported ending, not independent proof of clinical review.
cues.lines:
The history preserves a user-reported ending, not
independent proof of clinical review.

cues.text: Take the plan to the next conversation. The visit brief keeps follow-ups and source text together.
cues.lines:
Take the plan to the next conversation. The visit brief
keeps follow-ups and source text together.

cues.text: Calendar entries use confirmed dates.
cues.lines: Calendar entries use confirmed dates.

cues.text: In a signed-in care space, create a plan and refresh: the saved plan returns.
cues.lines:
In a signed-in care space, create a plan and refresh: the
saved plan returns.

cues.text: The first customer to test is a primary-care or transitions coordinator already chasing discharge follow-up.
cues.lines:
The first customer to test is a primary-care or transitions
coordinator already chasing discharge follow-up.

cues.text: The starting price hypothesis is one hundred and forty-nine dollars a month, for one hundred episodes.
cues.lines:
The starting price hypothesis is one hundred and forty-nine
dollars a month, for one hundred episodes.

cues.text: A supervised pilot must test preparation time and correction burden.
cues.lines:
A supervised pilot must test preparation time and correction
burden.

cues.text: Looplight is a working prototype evaluated on synthetic examples.
cues.lines:
Looplight is a working prototype evaluated on synthetic
examples.

cues.text: It can miss instructions and needs human review.
cues.lines: It can miss instructions and needs human review.

cues.text: It does not diagnose, interpret a result, or demonstrate a proven health benefit.
cues.lines:
It does not diagnose, interpret a result, or demonstrate a
proven health benefit.

cues.text: Shivam Gupta built Looplight with AI-assisted development.
cues.lines: Shivam Gupta built Looplight with AI-assisted development.

cues.text: Every next step has a source, a person tracking it, and a recorded ending.
cues.lines:
Every next step has a source, a person tracking it, and a
recorded ending.

cues.text: That is the work Looplight helps make visible.
cues.lines: That is the work Looplight helps make visible.
